summary: d·z = ∑ (d·r(x))·v(x) is an O_ι-combination of vectors of M.

steps.claim: By h, z = ∑_x r(x)·v(x) with r supported in A and d·r(x) ∈ integralAway(n) for all x.

d·z = ∑_{x ∈ supp r} (d·r(x))·v(x). Each d·r(x) lies in integralAway(n), so |ιₚ(d·r(x))|_l ≤ 1 because l is a prime coprime to n (hq): d·r(x) ∈ O_ι. Each v(x) with x in the support lies in A, hence in M by hv. So every summand lies in M, and so does the sum.
steps.lean: simpa using! sum_mem (M.smul_mem ⟨_, h.2 _ l hq _⟩ ∘ hv · ∘ h.1 _)
